# Biophilic Products

> A comprehensive resource and community hub connecting architects, designers, and manufacturers in the biophilic design movement to create nature-inspired spaces that enhance well-being.

Biophilic Products serves as the central platform for the International Biophilic Products Association (IBPA), showcasing member products and providing educational resources on biophilic design principles, interior architecture, and sustainable materials. The site bridges design professionals with innovative biophilic solutions from leading manufacturers.

## Key Topics

- Biophilic Design
- Interior Design
- Architecture
- Well-being
- Natural Elements
- Sustainable Materials
- Water Features
- Aquatecture
- Sensory Experience
- Green Decor
- Color Perception
- IBPA Membership
- Built Environment
- Serene Spaces
- Biophilia

## Core Platform & Membership

- [Biophilic Products | Biophilic Design](https://biophilicproducts.org): IBPA homepage connecting architects, designers & manufacturers in biophilic design
- [Why Become a Member of the IBPA?](https://biophilicproducts.org/membership-ibpa): IBPA membership benefits and collaboration opportunities for biophilic design
- [Join the Biophilic Design Movement | Biophilic Products Membership](https://biophilicproducts.org/products): Member products directory featuring furniture, architecture & design solutions

## Member Products & Solutions

- [Mantra Inspired Furniture - Biophilic Products](https://biophilicproducts.org/products/mantra-inspired-furniture): Mantra Inspired Furniture member showcase: sustainable American-made furniture
- [Natural Wood Biophilic Design Products: mafi](https://biophilicproducts.org/products/mafi): mafi premium natural wood flooring & cladding for biophilic interior design
- [Materials Hub: Acelab](https://biophilicproducts.org/products/acelab): Acelab Materials Hub: AI-powered platform for material research & selection

## Design Guides & Principles

- [Biophilic Design Learning Center | Nature & Wellness](https://biophilicproducts.org/learning-center-about-biophilic-design): Educational resource on biophilic design principles, wellness & sustainability
- [Biophilic Design Architecture - Biophilic Products](https://biophilicproducts.org/architecture): Guide to biophilic architecture with case studies, materials & design strategies
- [Interior Design - Biophilic Products](https://biophilicproducts.org/interior-design): Guide to biophilic interior design with tips, case studies & product guides
- [Exterior Design - Biophilic Products](https://biophilicproducts.org/exterior-desing): Guide to biophilic exterior design: green roofs, water features & sustainability
- [Green Decor - Biophilic Products](https://biophilicproducts.org/green-decor): Resource on green decor, natural materials & biophilic design for interiors

## Health & Wellness Resources

- [Well-being - Biophilic Products](https://biophilicproducts.org/well-being): Resource on how biophilic design improves health, stress & cognitive performance

- [Biophilic Design Blog: nature-Inspired Interiors](https://biophilicproducts.org/biophilic-design-blog): Blog hub exploring biophilic design trends, wellness & nature-inspired interiors

- [Aquatecture in biophilic design: blending water and architecture](https://biophilicproducts.org/biophilic-design-blog/aquatecture-in-biophilic-design): Article on aquatecture integrating water features in biophilic design
